$comment: Launch pages family. scripts/build-registry.mjs turns every entry in `items` into a registry item at /r/<name>.json; apps/docs/scripts/build-catalog.mjs turns them into /templates/<name> pages. License tier per item lives in source/licenses.json.
title: Launch pages
intro: Eight pieces for putting a product in front of people, in HeiGin's voice: a cream waitlist page whose highlighted words swap when tapped, a changelog with dates that stay pinned while each release scrolls past, a blue closing call to action with pixel hearts rising from a photo, a clean hero whose prompt types itself over a landscape, a single-plan pricing page whose add-ons grow a pile of 3D icons, a dark careers page with stacking values, a crew grid and open roles, a dark agents landing page with live agent runs, and a light platform landing page with a self-advancing product tour. No animation library; each installs on its own.
previewNote: Shown with the HeiGin brand and sample content. The photos and the pricing page's 3D icons (Microsoft Fluent Emoji, MIT) in the preview are not part of the download; empty image slots draw a soft gradient or a plain backdrop.
requirements: @heigin/ui 0.2.0 or newer (for HeiGinMark, Avatar and the CRM panels in the changelog); the changelog page also needs 0.3.0 or newer, for SectionIndex
A "@/" import alias pointing at your source root (the shadcn default)
setup: Install the item with the shadcn CLI. It adds the files listed above plus launch-core, which every piece shares.
Import the stylesheet once in your global CSS, after Tailwind and the HeiGin tokens: @import "tailwindcss"; @import "@heigin/ui/styles.css"; @import "@heigin/ui/tailwind.css"; @import "./launch.css";

Load the display faces from Google Fonts in your document head: Figtree (waitlist), Newsreader and Geist Mono (hero), Instrument Serif (call to action), Geist (open roles), Inter 300 (the pricing headline) and Caveat (the waitlist's handwritten label). Without them the stacks in launch.css fall back to system faces.
Edit lib/launch-config.ts: brand, copy, links, sample records and your images all live there.

items.name: launch-core
items.title: Launch core
items.description: Shared foundation for the launch pages: the content config, the brand mark (the HeiGin mark until you set your own logo), the inline-copy parser, the typing loop and the stylesheet.
items.responsive: Shared pieces only; each page and section documents its own breakpoints.
replaceable: Brand: the HeiGin mark and name until brand.logoSrc and brand.name are set.

items.name: launch-waitlist
items.title: Waitlist page
items.description: A cream waitlist page. Six photo tiles pop in on an arc around a centre tile that sketches itself in marker, and the headline's yellow-highlighted words blur into their next option when tapped while the highlight stretches to fit. An email form joins the list and shows a pending and a success state.
items.responsive: One centred column at every width; the nav links show from 768px and the tiles and headline scale down to fit a 375px phone.
replaceable: Tile photos: six image paths in waitlist.tiles; tiles without one show a gradient.
Pass onJoin to send the address to your mailing list. Without it the form only shows its success state.

items.name: launch-changelog
items.title: Changelog page
items.description: A quiet changelog on off-white. Each release keeps its date pinned in a left column while its notes scroll past, and its figures set live HeiGin panels (an approval card, the shared inbox, pipeline metrics, an activity timeline) over a photo. Entries rise in as they reach the window, and from 1280px a section index at the left edge marks the current release and opens into a list of them on hover.
items.responsive: From 768px the date sits in its own pinned column; on phones it moves above each title and scrolls with it.
replaceable: Releases, dates and the sample records in the panels live in changelog.entries and changelog.panels.
Figure photos: set figure.image per figure; without one the panel sits on plain grey.

items.name: launch-cta
items.title: Blue call to action
items.description: A closing call to action on a deep blue field: a tall serif headline, two buttons and a row of customer avatars that fans out on hover. A photo along the foot takes on the blue and fades up into it, pixel hearts and message bubbles float up from it, and stars twinkle along the top edge.
items.responsive: One centred column; the headline and the photo strip scale with the window down to 375px.
replaceable: The avatar names and the proof line are sample content; show real customers only with their permission.
The foot photo: set cta.image; without one the section ends in a darker blue band.

items.name: launch-hero
items.title: Prompt hero
items.description: A clean product hero: a serif headline that mixes roman and italic, an announcement chip and two calls to action over a photo panel whose prompt types itself, clears and types the next one. The photo drifts as the panel scrolls by, and a three-column strip of doc links sits under it.
items.responsive: Nav links show from 768px. Below that the panel turns portrait and the link strip stacks.
replaceable: The panel photo: set hero.image; without one it shows a gradient.
Prompts, features and links live in lib/launch-config.ts.

items.name: launch-pricing
items.title: Add-on pricing page
items.description: A single-plan pricing page on soft grey: a light headline, then one card with the list price struck through beside the discounted price and a switch per add-on. Each switch adds to both prices as they rise into place, sends its own group of 3D icons flying out from behind the card and swells the rest of the pile. A question list follows.
items.responsive: One centred column. Nav links show from 768px; below 640px the icon pile shrinks to 60% and stays around the card.
replaceable: Prices, add-ons and the discount are sample numbers in pricing; set your own before you publish.
Icons: add a src to each entry in pricing.icons and move them with x, y, size and rotate; icons without a src draw a soft gradient tile.

items.name: launch-careers
items.title: Careers page
items.description: A dark careers page in Geist. It opens on a full-bleed banner that redraws a photo as a grid of flickering grey pixels, then a People intro, then values that stack as you scroll (each one sticks while the next slides over it, with a black-and-white photo), then the crew: a list grouped by team beside a portrait grid, where hovering a name lights that person's photo and dims the rest. Open roles follow, bright with an apply link or dimmed when closed, with a hatch behind the row under the pointer, then an optional contact band.
items.responsive: From 1024px the headings sit in their own column, the values stick and the crew list stays beside the grid; below that everything stacks, values scroll normally and the grid drops to three or four columns.
replaceable: The crew are sample people: replace them with your team, with each person's permission, and add a photo per person; without one a portrait shows initials.

Banner: set careers.banner.image to the photo it pixelates; without one it flickers grey, and null leaves it out. Value photos: set an image per value (shown in black and white). Roles, teams, locations and the contact email are sample content in careers.
Set showClosed to false to list only open roles, or contact to null to drop the band.

items.name: launch-agents-page
items.title: Agents landing page
items.description: A dark landing page for an agents product. A large headline with a copy-a-prompt button, then a product window that rises and straightens as it scrolls in, where a new agent run arrives every few seconds in a live HeiGin table. The channels it reads, four jobs with small live demos (a shared inbox, leads changing status, follow-ups ticking off, a deal moving stage), feature rows that float a live HeiGin panel over a photo, a trust grid and a closing call to action.
items.responsive: The product window drops its sidebar below 768px and its metrics below 1024px, and the table hides its secondary columns on phones; jobs go from four columns to two to one, and feature rows stack.
replaceable: Every record in the product window, the demos and the panels is sample data in agentsPage, samples and changelog.panels.
Set agentsPage.hero.image and each feature's image to your photos; without one a soft gradient shows.

items.name: launch-platform-page
items.title: Platform landing page
items.description: A light landing page drawn on hairline grid lines. A headline that rises line by line, then a product tour whose five tabs advance on their own (the open tab's bar fills, then hands over, pausing while you hover or focus it) with a live HeiGin panel per tab. A grid of agents where each name rises to show its line on hover, a feature slider moved one card at a time by its arrows, a testimonial switcher that folds the other quotes into narrow tabs, a closing call to action and a footer.
items.responsive: Tour tabs wrap from five columns to three to two, the agent grid from four to two to one, slides scroll sideways at every width, and the testimonials stack below 768px. On touch screens the agent lines show without hover.
replaceable: The testimonials are placeholders: replace them with quotes your customers have approved in writing.
The agents, tour, slides and footer live in platformPage; the panel records are sample data in samples and changelog.panels.
